description:
You are the Warehouse Manager at Meridian Industrial Supply. To improve order accuracy and introduce a quality-check packing stage before dispatch, management has decided to upgrade the main warehouse to use 3-step outgoing shipment operations: Pick → Pack → Ship. After configuring the warehouse, create and fully process a sales order for the following items to be delivered to TechSource Procurement LLC:

- 3M 2050 General Purpose Masking Tape 2in 60yd (SKU: 3STEP-001): 20 units
- Protective Foam Roll 1/4in x 12in x 10ft (SKU: 3STEP-002): 15 units
- Scotch 3750 Heavy Duty Packing Tape 2in 60yd (SKU: 3STEP-003): 10 units

Process the delivery through all three stages — picking (move from storage), packing (consolidate at pack station), and shipping (hand off to carrier) — until the order is fully delivered. All three operations must be validated.

Login: http://localhost:8069 | Username: admin | Password: admin
